name: ZIGGI-6K Revitalise scales by level once and adds a quarter of the Tinker's spell power (#10819)
contract: Revitalizing Aura 524839 and Revitalise 524838 both read ${$524838m1*$<scalingbp>+$SP*.25} in Spell.dbc. Revitalise 524838 is SPELL_EFFECT_HEAL with BasePoints 154 + DieSides 1 = 155. ScalingBase(L) = 0.0267291844060354 + 0.0048541098014737*L + 0.0001859597762293*L^2 is 0.538346 at level 41 and 1.605201 at level 80, so the base heal is trunc(83.44) = 83 and trunc(248.81) = 248. Applying the curve twice gives 44 and 399. A Tinker without gear has no Nature spell power. The Drink Fel Infusion fixture 44505 adds exactly 2000 spell power to every school, so the level-80 heal must become trunc(248.81 + 0.25 * 2000) = 748. Without the spell power term it stays 248.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: the level 41 ZIGGI-6K is built
SETUP: the level 80 ZIGGI-6K is built
SETUP: the level 41 Tinker has no Nature spell power
SETUP: the level 80 Tinker has no Nature spell power
Level 41 Revitalise heals 155 scaled by the level curve once
Level 80 Revitalise heals 155 scaled by the level curve once
Grant the fixed +2000 all-school spell power fixture
SETUP: the fixture adds exactly 2000 Nature spell power
Revitalise adds a quarter of the Tinker's spell power
SETUP: the spell power fixture lasted through the measurement
